package.description: With iCloud for Windows, you can access your photos, videos, mail, calendar, files, and other important information on your Windows PC.

en-US.description: With iCloud for Windows, you can access your photos, videos, mail, calendar, files, and other important information on your Windows PC.
en-US.longDescription: After you set up iCloud on an iPhone, iPad, iPod touch or Mac, you can use iCloud for Windows to access your photos, videos, calendar, files and other important information on your Windows PC. Your information stays up to date on all your devices.
en-US.name: iCloud (Legacy)
